key_policy: Entity keys are type:slug; use actual destination IDs. existing_baseline.instructions: Locate and reuse the existing baseline by source tuple and mapping_version. Do not duplicate it into v2 or claim that the old synthetic documents are new real evidence.

projection_role_context.instructions: Use this only to enrich the view projection of existing events. Do not rewrite original v1 events or fabricate an original role reference.
